TITLE: FI Document Posting Fails with Vendor Invoice
DESCRIPTION: When posting a vendor invoice in FB60, the system throws a short dump 'CONVT_OVERFLOW' for amounts exceeding 999,999,999.99 in JPY currency.

TITLE: Goods Receipt Not Updating Stock Valuation
DESCRIPTION: MIGO goods receipt against a purchase order updates quantity but not the moving average price in MBEW. The cumulative stock value remains unchanged.

TITLE: Sales Order Billing Block Not Released via VA02
DESCRIPTION: Billing block set by delivery tolerances cannot be removed in VA02 even with full authorization. Work item remains in SBWP queue indefinitely.

TITLE: Asset Depreciation Run Arithmetik Error in Year-End
DESCRIPTION: AFAB depreciation posting for year-end shows rounding difference of 0.01 EUR for every 10th asset. Error occurs only in companies using pro-rata temporis method.

TITLE: Output Condition Record Missing for Customer Master
DESCRIPTION: VF01 invoice output determination fails for newly created customers. Condition record KOMG-KUNNR not generated despite having the output condition assigned in XD02.
